history.status.corruptCheckpoint: That version’s contents are damaged and were not opened. The rest of the timeline is unaffected.
history.status.evicted: This browser cleared its local storage, so the versions kept for this document are gone.
history.status.fullPinned: Version history is full and every version left is named, so none can be released. Stop keeping one to make room.
history.status.missingCheckpoint: That version’s contents are no longer stored, so it cannot be opened or restored.
history.status.nameRejected: Give the version a name of between 1 and 120 characters.
history.status.notDue: No new version yet — versions are kept at intervals, not on every edit.
history.status.overBudget: This document is larger than all the space version history is allowed. Raise the storage budget in Settings to keep versions of it.
history.status.pinLimit: As many versions are being kept as the policy allows. Stop keeping one before naming another.
history.status.pruned: Older versions were released to stay inside the retention policy.
history.status.quotaExhausted: This browser is out of storage, so the version was not kept. Free some space, or save the document to a file.
history.status.recorded: Version saved to this document’s history.
history.status.restoreCommitted: Restored. The version you replaced is still in this document’s history.
history.status.restorePrepared: Ready to restore — the document on screen has been kept as a version first.
history.status.staleHead: Another tab changed this document’s history. Close version history and open it again to see where it is now.
history.status.storeUnavailable: This browser would not open local storage, so no versions are being kept.
history.status.unchanged: Nothing has changed since the last version.
history.status.unknownFailure: That version could not be saved, and the reason is not known.
history.status.unknownOperation: That restore is no longer in progress. Start it again from the timeline.
history.status.unknownVersion: That version is no longer in this document’s history.
